items.label: MA-AG civil: Starion Energy, Inc.
items.detail: Suffolk Superior Court consent judgment over deceptive electricity sales tactics; date is the announcement date (judgment entered the previous Tuesday). Release says up to $10 million: $7.25 million restitution, $250,000 penalties and $2.5 million for bill assistance programs, of which $2 million is forgiven if Starion complies, so the firm amount is $8 million. Two principals are co-defendants and are left out. Amount entered is the firm $8 million; the conditional $2 million is not counted.

excluded_amounts.reason: Release: Starion "will pay up to $10 million including $7.25 million in restitution ... and $250,000 in penalties"; "Of the remaining $2.5 million, $2 million will be forgiven if Starion complies with the terms of the settlement." Counted: $8 million. Not counted: the $2 million that is forgiven on compliance.
